title: Digital Skin, Digital Bias: Uncovering Tone-Based Biases in LLMs and Emoji Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating tokenization cost asymmetry, measuring semantic drift using Cosine Distance and Word Mover's Distance, assessing neutral word associations via Relative Norm Distance (RND), applying the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to quantify implicit associations with positive/negative attributes and societal stereotypes, and calculating Relative Negative Sentiment Bias (RNSB) across varying emoji skin tone modifiers.
